name: acm-policy-helper
description: UI tool to generate ACM Configuration Policies from YAML manifests using PolicyGenerator

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:cluster: RUN_CLUSTER_TESTS=1 POLICY_GENERATOR_BIN="${POLICY_GENERATOR_BIN:-$PWD/e2e/bin/PolicyGenerator}" npm run test -w backend -- tests/template-deploy.cluster.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
